title: 高中数学引入大模型自适应 AI Tutor 评估
question: Should generative AI adaptive tutors be introduced for after-school personalized learning in high school mathematics (analytic geometry and calculus)? Does it improve conceptual modeling vs procedural calculation, and what is the urban-rural equity impact?

nodes.name: EV-MATH-001: algebraic_derivation_speed_and_accuracy (g=+0.68)
nodes.quote: Step-level adaptive prompting accelerates in-task algebraic calculation and conic equation derivation speed by 32% (g = +0.68).

nodes.name: EV-MATH-002: geometric_proof_modeling_score (g=+0.46)
nodes.quote: Socratic dialogue guidance significantly enhances high-order geometric modeling and multi-representation transfer (g = +0.46).

nodes.name: EV-MATH-003: delayed_unassisted_exam_score (g=-0.31)
nodes.quote: Unfettered direct solution access causes cognitive offloading, reducing delayed unassisted retention exam scores by 15% (g = -0.31).

nodes.name: EV-MATH-004: standardized_math_achievement_gap (g=+0.12)
nodes.quote: AI tutor effectiveness in rural high schools is moderated by infrastructure and teacher mediation, yielding a null net effect under unassisted conditions (g = +0.12).

nodes.name: EV-MATH-005: concept_transfer_and_gaming_rate (g=+0.54)
nodes.quote: A 4-phase fading scaffold protocol eliminates hint exploitation and enhances conceptual transfer in analytic geometry (g = +0.54).

nodes.name: EV-MATH-006: rate_of_change_conceptual_test (g=+0.38)
nodes.quote: Dynamic graphical representation linked with AI guidance significantly deepens understanding of tangent slope limits (g = +0.38).

nodes.name: EV-MATH-007: homework_completion_velocity (g=+0.72)
nodes.quote: Daily math homework completion duration decreased by 35% with high immediate accuracy during AI-present practice (g = +0.72).

nodes.name: EV-MATH-008: equity_gap_narrowing_metric (g=+0.22)
nodes.quote: Teacher-orchestrated AI tutoring disproportionately benefits baseline-low students, narrowing the achievement gap by 0.22g.

nodes.name: EV-MATH-009: non_routine_modeling_task_score (g=+0.41)
nodes.quote: Forcing students to verbalize mathematical invariants before receiving AI guidance enhances non-routine modeling transfer (g = +0.41).

nodes.name: EV-MATH-010: unassisted_differentiation_exam (g=-0.27)
nodes.quote: Students relying on bottom-out hints exhibited severe scaffolding dependency, declining by -0.27g on unassisted derivative tests.

nodes.name: EV-MATH-011: conceptual_schema_formation (g=+0.49)
nodes.quote: Pairing AI-generated skeleton solutions with required student self-explanation produces robust conceptual schemas (g = +0.49).

nodes.name: EV-MATH-012: rural_urban_parity_index (g=+0.35)
nodes.quote: Teacher-in-the-loop AI orchestration in rural high schools closed 45% of the baseline achievement gap with urban benchmarks (g = +0.35).

nodes.name: EV-MATH-013: cognitive_load_efficiency (g=+0.58)
nodes.quote: Step-by-step focused prompting reduces extraneous cognitive load, accelerating multi-step conic equation proofs (g = +0.58).

nodes.name: EV-MATH-014: cross_regional_exam_score (g=+0.05)
nodes.quote: Deploying generic AI resources without regional curriculum alignment yielded no significant equity improvement (g = +0.05).

nodes.name: EV-MATH-015: geometric_reasoning_rigor (g=+0.44)
nodes.quote: Epistemic feedback prompting locus invariant verification significantly improves analytical geometry modeling rigor (g = +0.44).

nodes.name: EV-MATH-016: semester_end_unassisted_retention (g=-0.22)
nodes.quote: A 16-week unguided homework app intervention led to a persistent negative retention deficit on unassisted final exams (g = -0.22).

nodes.value: In-task algebraic calculation and conic equation derivation speed.

nodes.name: 📊 Conceptual Modeling (高阶概念建模)
nodes.value: Geometric proof modeling and multi-representation calculus understanding.

nodes.name: 📊 Solo Retention (脱离AI闭卷留存)
nodes.value: Delayed unassisted exam retention after scaffolding withdrawal.

nodes.name: 📊 Urban-Rural Equity (城乡校际公平性)
nodes.value: Narrowing the achievement divide between urban and county/rural schools.

nodes.name: C-001: LLM adaptive step-level ...
nodes.value: LLM adaptive step-level hints significantly accelerate in-task procedural derivation and algebra speed (pooled g = +0.66, p < 0.001).
nodes.quote: High in-task velocity does not guarantee delayed unassisted retention without fading scaffolds.

nodes.name: C-002: Socratic inquiry prompti...
nodes.value: Socratic inquiry prompting and multi-representation feedback enhance high-order geometric and calculus modeling (pooled g = +0.46, p < 0.001).
nodes.quote: High in-task velocity does not guarantee delayed unassisted retention without fading scaffolds.

nodes.name: C-003: Unguided direct solution...
nodes.value: Unguided direct solution dumping induces severe cognitive offloading, impairing delayed unassisted exam retention (pooled g = -0.27, p < 0.001).
nodes.quote: High in-task velocity does not guarantee delayed unassisted retention without fading scaffolds.

nodes.name: C-004: Urban-rural equity narro...
nodes.value: Urban-rural equity narrowing is strictly conditioned on subsidized hardware and teacher orchestration, failing to narrow under unguided home use (pooled g = +0.18, p = 0.001).
nodes.quote: High in-task velocity does not guarantee delayed unassisted retention without fading scaffolds.

nodes.name: ⚠️ Scaffolding Dependency Trap
nodes.value: Students develop an illusion of competence when given constant hints, suffering a -0.27g deficit during unassisted exams.
nodes.quote: Enforce the 4-phase progressive fading protocol and anchor summative grading in unassisted closed-book exams.

nodes.name: ⚠️ Urban-Rural Digital Divide
nodes.value: Rural county schools lack sufficient device hardware and teacher orchestration, risking a null net benefit under unguided home use.
nodes.quote: Provide subsidized classroom tablets and comprehensive teacher-in-the-loop dashboard training.

nodes.name: 🔬 Longitudinal Gaokao Retention Gap
nodes.value: Lack of multi-semester longitudinal tracking following students through the National College Entrance Examination.
nodes.quote: Pre-registered 2-year longitudinal cohort study tracking Gaokao math performance.

nodes.name: ⚖️ PILOT
nodes.value: Synthesis of 16 empirical studies demonstrates that while adaptive AI tutoring accelerates in-task procedural calculation (+0.66g) and enhances conceptual modeling (+0.46g) under Socratic scaffolding, unguided access causes severe delayed retention loss (-0.27g) and risks widening urban-rural inequities without teacher mediation. An unconstrained rollout is strongly contraindicated, while an outright ban deprives resource-strained students of vital personalized assistance. Therefore, a restricted PILOT verdict is adjudicated: implementing a strict 4-phase fading scaffolding protocol with mandatory closed-book solo assessment and hard stop thresholds.
nodes.quote: Applicable to after-school personalized homework and variation practice in high school mathematics (analytic geometry and introductory calculus); strictly prohibited during closed-book exams or unmonitored home free usage.
